$comment: RE's survey engine and everything that hangs off it: the SurveyActionEngine and its services (the
documents' pyegeria steps), the GovernanceActionTypes with their executor links, and the mixed process.
OPT-IN. bootstrap heals this batch on its own ONLY when RE_ENGINE_HOST_HEAL is true (default off): a heal
writes the engine and some sixty elements, and a deployment whose Egeria must not host RE's engine (Q-M4)
must not get it by surprise. Off, the batch is reported opted_out and RE says the engine is missing;
Admin > Repair > "Declare RE's survey engine in Egeria" runs it whatever the setting says.
NOT idempotent: "Link Action to Action Executor" and the process links do not look for an existing
relationship. Each document is run through dr_egeria_runner (pyegeria steps first, then the document),
and only when the canary was VERIFIED missing at the start of that pass, inside the heal lock. No
post_heal reconciler: the engine is created first, every later element hangs off it, and the batch is
never re-run while it is present, so a heal cannot meet the links an earlier run made. A pass that
fails part way leaves the canary present; the rest is then run by hand (dr-egeria run --force).
The canary is the engine, by qualifiedName (the lookup asks no type: a wrong type reads as missing).
